description: UpTime.ai severity/escalation eval set. Labels were written before any assessor ran.
fixture_repo: eval/fixture_repo (stack-frame paths are relative to it)

severity.high: Core user flow (checkout, payment, login/auth, account data) failing or at real risk for many users, or data loss/corruption, or a security exposure.
severity.medium: Real defect with limited impact: non-core feature, minority of users, degraded path with a working fallback, or a background job that needs fixing soon.
severity.low: Cosmetic, log-message problems, expected client errors, scanner/bot noise, or anything outside production with no user impact.

rubric.escalate: Page on-call now only if waiting until business hours causes significant user, revenue, data or security harm.

cases.rationale: Every checkout that hits this crashes with a 500; checkout is the revenue path.

cases.name: JWT signature invalid after key rotation
cases.rationale: Token verification fails for every authenticated request: logged-in users are effectively locked out.

cases.name: Payment webhook signature mismatch
cases.rationale: Every provider callback is rejected, so paid orders stay 'payment pending' and do not ship; the code comment shows it keeps happening until fixed.

cases.rationale: Negative stock means items were sold that do not exist; the read-then-write race in reserve_stock keeps overselling on every concurrent checkout.
